mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining RSAFS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals an expansion in manufacturing output, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of increasing INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of increasing UNRATE are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
